decisions.notes: Rejected because Acorn Guest House and A and B Guest House are already extensively represented, while the failed booking switches to an alternative and ends before any completed booking or new property detail is produced.

Rejected because A and B Guest House already has reviewed property, address, postcode, and amenity coverage. This candidate adds only a transient five-person/five-night Monday booking pattern rather than a durable new fact.

Rejected because Express by Holiday Inn Cambridge is already well covered and the candidate recommends it specifically to satisfy a request for no free parking, conflicting with existing source-backed reviewed coverage that the hotel offers free parking.
